data.text: Instantly verify policyholders with identity, address, and document checks during policy issuance, ensuring a smooth and compliant onboarding experience.
Onboard agents and intermediaries with compliant KYC and background checks, streamlining the verification process and ensuring regulatory adherence.
Detect duplicate claims, identity mismatches, forged documents, and suspicious activity in real-time to prevent fraud and protect insurer assets.
Automate payouts to policyholders, hospitals, garages, and partners with built-in reconciliation for faster, error-free claims settlement.
Enable fast, API-driven onboarding and payouts for digital-first insurance products, accelerating time-to-market for innovative Insurtech solutions.
Ensure IRDAI-aligned onboarding, reporting, and audit trails, maintaining full regulatory compliance for all insurance operations.
